_comment: e2r MCP server — OpenCode v2 config. Merge the "mcp" object into opencode.json (project root) or ~/.config/opencode/opencode.json (global), then restart OpenCode. V2 form: server names go under mcp.servers. (Older OpenCode v1 placed server names directly under "mcp" — if your version ignores mcp.servers, move the "e2r" entry up one level under "mcp".) The command must resolve on PATH (cargo install --path converters/electron/crates/e2r-cli); otherwise use the absolute path, usually ~/.cargo/bin/e2r, as the first element of "command".
